thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT — Elevated fncall + structured-output throughput from us-west-2-hosted cluster. Error 429s trending up, KPS spike 4.8x, started ~23s ago. Paging oncall.

matt: oncall here, ack. jumping in. any obvious root cause?

sara: looking at traces now — many requests are invoking tool calls with large structured JSON responses (heavy token output). Top offending model: open-legacy-v1, mostly free-plan tenants.

liam: confirming tenant list: t-412, t-819, t-214. traffic looks bot-like fanout from a single client key.

matt: immediate mitigation proposal — soft attenuation play:
1) throttle fncall paths for free plan to 20% of baseline
2) switch free-plan to plain-text output (disable structured streaming & function call payloads)
3) apply per-tenant quota overrides for top offenders
4) monitor for 10-15m then re-evaluate

matt: executing flags now — snippet I'm running:
```bash
redwoodctl featureflag set restrict_fncalls --value=on --scope=plan:free --expires=15m
redwoodctl featureflag set disable_structured_output --value=on --scope=plan:free --expires=15m
redwoodctl quota override tenant t-412 --max-fncall 10
redwoodctl quota override tenant t-819 --max-fncall 10
```

sara: applied in canary region, CPU & GPU queue depth down ~28% in 60s. no immediate customer 5xx increase.

ops-bot: rollout triggered by matt — FFID ff-2026-91; canary->global in progress (no downtime): action_id:5681

matt: pushing global now.

liam: watching logs — 429s dropping, token egress down 46% for affected tenants. latency back to baseline.

emily: support note: drafting message for impacted customers, will include expected auto-revert time (15m) and offer to whitelist if legitimate traffic. attaching affected tenant IDs.

matt: handing incident to sara for post-mitigation follow-up + runbook update. I'll be available for 10m then off-duty.

sara: will create INC ticket and runbook entry. scheduling postmortem, and creating follow-up to improve fncall backpressure and model-level output caps (TKT-789).

incident-bot: Incident created INC-2026-457 (severity: S2), owner: sara, start_ts: 2573456789.

emily: noted — support will send templated comms in 30m if still impacted.

matt: thanks team. mark mitigated after 15m if metrics remain stable; if not, escalate to service-ops for rate-limiter increases and tenant quarantine.

sara: acknowledged. will keep thread updated with metrics snapshots and decision points.
